whatIs.title: Who are we?
whatIs.description: Kazakh Hub is a code sharing and collaboration platform for Kazakhstani developers. We help develop the Kazakhstani IT community and knowledge exchange.

mission.description: Our mission is to create a convenient platform for Kazakhstani developers for code sharing, knowledge exchange, and collaboration. We support open source and rely on community development.
